name: evigraph-studio
description: EviGraph Studio: Theia + GLSP IDE over the EviGraph Core API
license: (EPL-2.0 OR GPL-2.0 WITH Classpath-exception-2.0 OR MIT)

scripts.all: yarn clean && yarn install && yarn lint
scripts.bundle: node scripts/prepare-monaco-sanitizer.cjs && node scripts/prepare-cli-decompress.cjs && node scripts/prepare-deepmerge.cjs && node scripts/prepare-minimatch.cjs && node scripts/prepare-opfs.cjs && yarn server bundle && yarn browser bundle
scripts.clean: yarn workspace evigraph-glsp-client clean && yarn workspace evigraph-glsp-server clean && yarn workspace evigraph-theia clean
scripts.test:security: node --test scripts/test-sanitizer-backport.cjs scripts/test-cli-tooling.cjs scripts/test-cli-decompress.cjs scripts/test-cli-matching.cjs scripts/test-cli-remaining.cjs scripts/test-deepmerge.cjs scripts/test-minimatch-backport.cjs scripts/test-opfs-backport.cjs && node scripts/test-opfs-backport.cjs --browser && node scripts/test-studio-security.cjs
scripts.watch: concurrently --kill-others -n tsc,browser,server -c red,yellow "tsc -b -w --preserveWatchOutput" "yarn -s browser watch" "yarn -s server watch:bundle"
